text:
anika_cs: @here quick heads-up :wave: Aurelia Health onboarding has slipped 2 sprints and we have a renewal signal hitting the account team in ~6w. Want to run an aggressive enablement push: 3 short hands-on workshops + office hours the next 2 weeks. Need to pool facilitators and lock a repeatable cadence. Constraints: max 2 facilitators/day, cover EMEA + APAC overlap, capture feedback for feature/regression risk.

jamal_se: I can take APAC-evening blocks most days next 2 weeks. prefer 18:00-20:00 UTC. :+1:

sofia_impl: Happy to run the EMEA-morning session (08:00-10:00 UTC). I can do a product + migration playbook deep-dive. Quick suggested agenda pasted below — ok to iterate.
```
20m - Welcome & goals (CS)
30m - Migration checklist + Dedicated sizing (Impl)
25m - Live demo: model pinning / rollbacks (Eng)
15m - Q&A / next steps + feedback form
```

mike_eng: I can cover the live demo piece and tooling tips. I only have limited APAC evenings (Mon/Wed/Thu). For Dedicated sizing, share the customer's QPS pattern (or rough requests/sec) and I'll prep a config snippet.

anika_cs: thanks. customer constraints: 12k tokens/day typical; burst windows on Mon/Tue; currently on hosted but evaluating Dedicated. Renewal note: exec is asking for cost/latency improvements as a condition of renewal discussions. we should capture pre/post metrics per session.

oliver_cs_manager: Can we add a prework checklist to reduce time wasted? simple asks: share current prompts, sample logs, and expected concurrency. I'll draft an email template. Also we need a short feedback pulse (2 questions) immediately after each session to tie to quality/regression.

liam_sched_bot: Availability scan complete. Potential facilitator pool: 
- sofia_impl: EMEA mornings (08:00-10:00 UTC) available daily
- jamal_se: APAC evenings (18:00-20:00 UTC) Mon/Wed/Thu
- mike_eng: APAC evenings Mon/Wed/Thu (limited)

anika_cs: Proposed schedule (please react with :thumbsup: to claim a slot)
- 2025-03-12 08:00-10:00 UTC (EMEA) - sofia_impl tentative
- 2025-03-12 18:00-20:00 UTC (APAC) - jamal_se tentative
- 2025-03-14 08:00-10:00 UTC (EMEA) - open
- 2025-03-14 18:00-20:00 UTC (APAC) - open

sofia_impl: :thumbsup: locking 2025-03-12 EMEA morning. I'll add the agenda to the invite and attach the prework checklist.

jamal_se: :thumbsup: locking 2025-03-12 APAC evening. i'll handle setup and the zoom link.

mike_eng: I can take 2025-03-14 APAC evening if still needed.

oliver_cs_manager: I'll prepare the feedback pulse and a short A/B prompt set for quality monitoring. Suggest we record sessions (opt-in) so we can clip demo steps for docs.

anika_cs: Great — next action items:
- sofia_impl: add invites + agenda + prework by EOD
- jamal_se & mike_eng: confirm facilitator runbooks and demo scripts
- oliver_cs_manager: feedback pulse + renewal note to execs
- liam_sched_bot: block calendar slots and set reminders for participants

anika_cs: If anyone else can volunteer as backup (holiday overlap risk), pls reply here. We want at least one backup per timezone. :spiral_calendar:
